name: TV1-ceiling-into-the-cloud
note: Mac's call: below the clouds. Without the margin the eye rides the deck's base and the view is cloud.

name: TV1-eye-not-back-along-heading
note: The line of sight must pass through the traveller - the wrong trig puts them off the middle of the screen.

name: TV1-flats-lean-the-whole-tilt
note: Half the tilt: a flat leaned the whole way lies face-up to the eye and loses its foot.

name: TV1-tilt-unclamped
old: return { ...c, yaw: c.yaw + dYaw, tilt: clamp(c.tilt + dTilt, TV_TILT_MIN, TV_TILT_MAX) };
new: return { ...c, yaw: c.yaw + dYaw, tilt: c.tilt + dTilt };
note: A long drag tilts past straight down (the view flips) or to the horizon (the far ring is all there is).

name: TV1-jump-eased-across-the-world
note: A fast travel or a respawn swept the camera over the leagues between - through unloaded ground.

name: TV1-fog-from-the-camera
note: From 330 m up a rain fog swallowed the traveller - the probe's case; the source pin catches it in node.

name: TV1-cascades-from-the-camera
note: The cascades stood about a point in the sky and no shadow reached the ground under the view.

name: TV1-focus-unset-stamp-lost
note: Down from the view the blocks kept the focus of the sky - the fog stayed the traveller's head's until something else moved the stamp.

name: TV1-escape-opens-the-pause
note: Esc leaves the view - and must never also reach the host's pause (the field bug this branch fixed once already).

name: TV1-underwater-rises
old: if (dwPlayer?.submerged) return { ok: false, why: TRAVEL_VIEW_TEXT.underwater };
note: Under the sea the view would lift out of the water and the breath clock would run on unseen.

name: TV1-fog-from-the-camera-in-world
note: The host never hands the renderer the traveller - the focus machinery is dead weight.
